preprocessing_cmd: python3 data/scripts/sample_replogle_2022.py -- ranks perturbations by annotated_embedding_coordinates.csv's Anderson-Darling DE gene count (desc), takes the top 100; for each, ranks measured genes in clustered_mean_gene_expression_figs2-4.csv.gz by |z-score| (desc), takes the top 100; maps both perturbed- and measured-gene symbols through this repo's own frozen HGNC snapshot (unmapped symbols dropped, never invented); writes one perturbation_effect EvidenceRecord per kept pair (cap 20000).
